Social

SOH-shuhl · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Social is relating to people living and spending time together in groups.

Recess is the most social part of the day, full of games with friends.

Worked Example

Wolves are social animals that live and hunt in packs.

Wolves live together in groups instead of alone. Living and doing things in groups is what social means.

How Social Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

friendly

friendly: enjoying being with people

outgoing

outgoing: loving to meet and talk with others

Antonyms

solitary

solitary: liking to be alone

shy

shy: nervous around other people

How Strong Is It? — Friendly → social → Outgoing

Friendly vs. social

Friendly vs. social: Friendly is milder: a friendly wave takes one second.

Outgoing vs. social

Outgoing vs. social: Outgoing is stronger: an outgoing camper introduces herself to the whole cabin on day one.
